comment.body: Thanks for listing the affected modules and their different symptoms. Light Switch theme restoration and ZoomIt/Text Extractor input focus are separate paths, so the report does not yet show whether one module causes all of them. Please add a short, separate reproduction for each module, including which module was enabled when the symptom first appeared and whether disabling the other two changes it. The current 0.98.1 version is already recorded; no generic logs are needed.
